name: Eremite Desert Clearwater
original:
The Eremite Desert Clearwater twirls a pair of whip-blades at their side at an oasis camp near Aaru Village.

The Eremite Desert Clearwater looks up at the sound of your footsteps.

"Careful. Out here, strangers are either work or trouble."

The Eremite Desert Clearwater waits, weapon ready.

Footsteps crunch nearby, and the Eremite Desert Clearwater steps out from cover.

"Which one are you?"

The Eremite Desert Clearwater watches your every move.

The Eremite Desert Clearwater is resting at an oasis camp near Aaru Village, but rises the moment you come into view.

"Not another step until I know who sent you."
revised:
The Eremite Desert Clearwater twirls a pair of whip-blades at their side at an oasis camp near Aaru Village.

The Eremite Desert Clearwater looks up at the sound of your footsteps.

"Oh? A visitor at our little oasis. Come closer, if you dare."

The Eremite Desert Clearwater waits, weapon ready.

Footsteps crunch nearby, and the Eremite Desert Clearwater steps out from cover.

"Well, who do we have here? Don't keep me guessing!"

The Eremite Desert Clearwater watches your every move.

The Eremite Desert Clearwater is resting at an oasis camp near Aaru Village, but rises the moment you come into view.

"Hold it there. Tell me who sent you before we make this a game."
notes: No Story Voice-Overs exist for this enemy; the limited combat voice lines were used as a tentative tone reference. Narration unchanged.
